name: ultraweb
description: Guided webdesign harness for Next.js: a dynamic scoping interview, a three-candidate mockup round (side-by-side or pairwise tournament), and human-in-the-loop checkpoints on a real-studio cadence — first-page review on the built homepage, preflight/UAT acceptance before ship, preview URLs so you review on your own phone, a dial from hands-off to full sign-off plus a scope dial from sketch to flagship (classic one-prompt autonomous mode on request) — 80 interlocking skills with real-world worked examples, four model-routed subagents (Opus 5 / Sonnet 5, including a Sonnet gate-runner that keeps the six measurement gates out of the lead context), design taste enforced at write time by hooks, an award-canon study library distilled from Awwwards-winning sites, client-asset intake, brand-mark identity, design systems, components, motion — including a DIRECTION-gated anime.js SVG-choreography engine and a DIRECTION-gated site-scale immersive-3D build — Next.js engineering, backend, quality gates, a live in-build /studio dashboard, progress + resume across interruptions, and a cross-build taste fingerprint
